boundary_answers.what_it_verifies: Hermetic decision tests for the governed platform database ops entries. The two ops entries (``scripts/ops/platform_database_register.py`` and ``scripts/ops/platform_database_lifecycle_apply.py``) are the only production callers of the platform registration model, and they are what turns a declared lifecycle state into a real environment fact. Their decision helpers stay importable without odoo, so the fail-closed refusals are proven here; the real PostgreSQL effect still requires an authorized governed runtime adapter and its actual readback. No such runtime result is claimed by these tests. These tests pin three boundaries the owner named: * the ops tool never decides a tenant, a purpose or an initialization rule on its own -- it consumes the declaration by module identity; * a request that would cut off the database serving the control plane, an unknown operation, a missing reason or a missing confirmation fails closed; * a lifecycle operation is never reported as an environment change unless the catalog readback shows the declared fact.
